_comment: Advisories that pip-audit reports and that have been read and judged not reachable from BloomLens. Anything NOT listed here fails the audit. Re-review when torch is upgraded (the fix for most of these is torch >= 2.7-2.13, blocked today by the pinned CPU build the eval numbers were measured on) and at least every 90 days.

entries.reason: Each advisory names a specific torch API (mkldnn_max_pool2d, ctc_loss, lstm_cell, torch.jit.script, the profiler, pad_packed_sequence/unpack_sequence, torch.compile/Inductor, nan_to_num, rot90, linalg.lu, to_sparse, ...) or the torch.load weights_only unpickler fed an untrusted checkpoint. Checked on 2026-09-21: a search of src/, api/, app.py, eval/ and scripts/ finds none of those APIs; BloomLens runs one open_clip ViT-L/14 image forward pass and a cosine search. The only file torch.load ever opens is the BioCLIP 2 weights, whose SHA-256 is pinned and verified (src/model_pin.py) before open_clip touches it, and open_clip loads with weights_only=True, so an attacker-supplied checkpoint would have to get past the pinned hash first. Upload bytes go to Pillow (patched), never to torch. Not checked: calls made inside open_clip/torch internals, which were not traced.
